intent: Operator-owned canonical branch. Main promotion accepts PRs from the staging git branch only, blocks direct pushes and force-pushes, and intentionally does not require ci / verify on staging -> main promotion. The staging git branch is not the CDK/release deploy-stage staging.

policy.direct_pushes: blocked by required pull request rule with enforce_admins=true and operator-only push restrictions
policy.operator_note: Operator should review/adjust operator_push_users or replace them with teams/apps before applying if governance ownership changes. GitHub classic branch protection does not expose a machine-enforced PR head-branch allowlist; the staging-only source rule is encoded here as the operator merge policy, while the API payload enforces PR-only, operator-owned updates, no direct pushes, and no force-pushes. Do not add ci / verify to main protection. The staging git branch is source-control only and is not the deploy-stage staging.
